name: @autonomos/app
description: autonomOS Desktop — thin Electron client over autonomos-server daemons

scripts.build:dmg: bun run build:main && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never

//comment_no_workspace_deps: Intentionally no workspace deps. The bundled autonomos-server lives in extraResources/server/ at build time, NOT in node_modules. Adding @autonomos/server here would make electron-builder try to rebuild node-pty against Electron's ABI.
